product_one_liner.value: Forwood Safety provides critical-risk management and fatality-prevention software for organizations in high-risk industries such as mining, construction and utilities.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link was found in the navigation or footer, and the pricing route did not return a pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The index primarily contains safety guidance and product news. One qualifying analytics article was identified; the AWS conference-video post does not establish a second engineer-authored technical article.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center includes user documentation and app-setup articles, with four articles under Forwood Users and one under Team Management.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The four listed openings comprise two sales roles and two Industry & Critical Risk Management Specialist roles; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services — Amazon QuickSight Q
model_provider.notes: Forwood describes using QuickSight Q's machine-learning-powered natural-language querying for safety analytics; it does not name an underlying foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 and ISO 27001:2022.

last_funding.notes: The latest listed round is dated 31 October 2023; its amount is not disclosed on the public profile.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round, October 2023, predates the 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive – Enterprise SaaS Sales posting includes an application button.

launched_6mo.notes: Forwood One's App Store release notes introduce the iOS app with field verifications, inspections, actions and offline synchronization. Version 1.9.2 release metadata is dated 2026-08-07, within the requested window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The four-person executive team was reviewed; no qualifying appointment or departure was publicly identified for 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09. The team page does not provide joining dates.
